high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an email from Elon Musk to Sam Altman dated December 8, 2015, at 9:29 AM. The email discusses the importance of getting the opening summary section right for a release aimed at attracting top talent. It emphasizes that this section will be what everyone reads and what the press mostly quotes. The content of the email outlines the mission and philosophy of OpenAI, a non-profit artificial intelligence research company.
